title: App Sidebar
description: A persistent studio sidebar with grouped navigation, account actions and a native drawer for small screens.
summary: Grouped rail navigation with a real mobile drawer strategy.
notes: The desktop rail and the mobile drawer are separate elements, as the Actual CSS navigation pattern recommends.
Opening the drawer uses the native command="show-modal" / commandfor pair. It needs a browser with native dialog command support; no JavaScript is bundled.
Project links, filters and account actions are placeholders for your application routes.
